residual: Supplied filtered measured minus predicted current, fixed DT; no DT retraining
measured_current_features: All features, including the absolute closing peak and RC, use supplied filtered measured current. Unfiltered current is used only to verify ROS/replay alignment, never as a feature.
windows: Opening and closing: initial3% of commanded travel excluded. No pauses. Closing RC:30-80% commanded closing travel.
sample_policy: Use all actual valid original samples. No fixed count and no extra endpoint.
interpolation: Only for DFT: uniform time grid with exactly the native valid sample count of that specific direction or active cycle. No interpolation across the omitted reversal gap. All other parameters use native samples/timestamps directly.
integrals: Native-sample trapezoids in seconds, including the existing first/last sample. Full cycle=sum separate opening+closing integrals; no excluded-gap integration.
phase_mean: Native-time integral divided by valid duration. Active-cycle integral divided by summed directional durations. Distinct from arithmetic sample mean.
sd: Population ddof0 on all native valid observations
fft: DFT on a uniform grid of N equal to actual observed sample count per window; h1/h2 describe profile shape, not physical rotation orders
joint: Pearson waveform correlation and pi sqrt(det(population covariance)) from paired original M0/M3 samples
